items.q: How do I set up multi-factor authentication (MFA)?
items.a:
Install the authenticator app, open the security page in the portal and scan the QR code.
Keep the backup codes somewhere safe, not on your laptop.

items.q: How do I report a phishing email?
items.a:
Use the Report phishing button in the mail client. Do not click links or open attachments.
If you already clicked, tell the security team immediately; it is never too late to report.
Press Report phishing. Never click links in it.
